name: Parent Company Linker
when_runs: On change; HQ or M&A news
writes_fields: parent_id, outreach lock at top parent

name: Headquarters Re-checker
when_runs: Nightly on news; quarterly on all
below_threshold_to: Patch tower alert, then Patch Suggester

name: Buying Signal Spotter
writes_fields: signals (type, date, source, strength); fade over 30 days

name: Weekly Slot Planner
writes_fields: slots per patch, pace boost up to +50%

name: Holdout Picker
threshold: 10% of new medium/low plays; std diff < 0.1

name: Gate 1
threshold: hard blocks: no Patch ID / AE / pod, AE hold, held out

name: Company Facts Collector
writes_fields: facts with quote, page, date, link

name: Use Case Matcher
writes_fields: top 3 UC-IDs with pattern and outcome

name: Past Contact Query
writes_fields: past contact (events, downloads, visits, calls, deals, loss reasons)

name: Account Tagger
writes_fields: vertical, Patch ID, size, systems, vendors, AI maturity, fit band, pattern, outcome

name: Buying Team Mapper
writes_fields: 3 Tier 1, 3 Tier 2, 4 Tier 3, 2 backups; gatekeeper mapped

name: Intro Finder
when_runs: Tier 1 at best fit; monthly exports
writes_fields: intro request in AE to-do; 7-day cold hold

name: Contact Finder
writes_fields: email, phone (Tier 1 and engaged), source, verify date

name: Do-Not-Contact List
threshold: DNC screen before any dialler; erasure in 30 days
writes_fields: suppression list, consent, hashed erasure code

name: Play Picker
writes_fields: play, people, channels, start days, senders

name: Page Builder
writes_fields: Art of the Possible page (noindex, tracked link)

name: Message Grader
below_threshold_to: one rewrite, then a person at Gate 2

name: Gate 2
threshold: one screen per account; ~5% planted errors
writes_fields: approve, edit, swap a person or hold

name: Outreach Launcher
threshold: 70% of daily limit; key person + play
writes_fields: Apollo sequence, Sprouts queue, HubSpot fields, parent lock

name: Follow-up Planner
writes_fields: lead thread, pauses, Committee Surge switch

name: Email Domain Swapper
threshold: placement under 70% twice or major blacklist

name: Reply Writer
writes_fields: drafted answer in BDR to-do; 90 min reminder

name: Meeting Handoff and Deadlines
writes_fields: deal at Engage, locked fields, SC booking, reminders, deadlines

name: Meeting Prep Writer
writes_fields: prep pack into the AE's AI Twin

name: Meeting Labeler
writes_fields: intro / New Buyer Meeting / doesn't count, with quotes

name: Deal Qualifier
writes_fields: six requirements met / partly / missing, recap

name: A/B Tester
threshold: 20% traffic per version; ~1,060 people for bold tests

name: Quality Grader
when_runs: Every prompt, model or weight change
writes_fields: rubrics, test sets, rungs, policy drafts

name: Test Error Planter
writes_fields: planted errors that never send; catch rate

name: Alarm and Escalation
writes_fields: pause, throttle, move slots, demote a gate, to-do

name: Content Handoff
threshold: 8 weeks of ads; nurture until date
